functions.name: get_analytics
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.get_analytics(p_organization_id uuid, p_from date, p_to date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_result jsonb;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null or (not private.is_platform_admin() and
      (p_organization_id is null or not private.has_permission(p_organization_id,'analytics'))) then
    raise exception 'Analytics permission required' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if p_from is null or p_to is null or p_to < p_from or p_to - p_from > 365 then
    raise exception 'Date range must contain 1 to 366 days' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  with events as materialized (
    select e.* from public.scan_events e
    where (p_organization_id is null or e.organization_id = p_organization_id)
      and e.created_at >= (p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Ulaanbaatar')
      and e.created_at < ((p_to + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Ulaanbaatar')
  ), card_totals as (
    select organization_id,card_id,count(*) as opens,
      count(*) filter (where source = 'qr') as qr,
      count(*) filter (where source = 'unknown') as unknown
    from events group by organization_id,card_id
  ), current_cards as (
    select c.* from public.nfc_cards c where p_organization_id is null or c.organization_id = p_organization_id
  ), cards as (
    select coalesce(c.id,t.card_id) as id,coalesce(c.organization_id,t.organization_id) as organization_id,
      c.name,c.code,c.is_active,coalesce(t.opens,0) as opens,coalesce(t.qr,0) as qr,coalesce(t.unknown,0) as unknown
    from current_cards c full join card_totals t on t.card_id = c.id and t.organization_id = c.organization_id
  ), daily as (
    select (created_at at time zone 'Asia/Ulaanbaatar')::date as day,count(*) as opens,
      count(*) filter (where source = 'qr') as qr,count(*) filter (where source = 'unknown') as unknown
    from events group by 1
  ), organizations as (
    select o.id,o.name,count(e.id) as opens,count(e.id) filter (where e.source = 'qr') as qr,
      count(e.id) filter (where e.source = 'unknown') as unknown
    from public.organizations o left join events e on e.organization_id = o.id
    where p_organization_id is null or o.id = p_organization_id group by o.id,o.name
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'totals',jsonb_build_object('opens',(select count(*) from events),'qr',(select count(*) from events where source = 'qr'),
      'unknown',(select count(*) from events where source = 'unknown'),
      'active_cards',(select count(*) from current_cards where is_active),
      'inactive_cards',(select count(*) from current_cards where not is_active)),
    'days',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('date',d.day::date,'opens',coalesce(t.opens,0),'qr',coalesce(t.qr,0),'unknown',coalesce(t.unknown,0)) order by d.day)
      from generate_series(p_from::timestamp,p_to::timestamp,interval '1 day') d(day) left join daily t on t.day = d.day::date),
    'cards',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) order by c.opens desc,c.id) from (select * from cards order by opens desc,id limit 100) c),'[]'::jsonb),
    'card_count',(select count(*) from cards),
    'organizations',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(o) order by o.opens desc,o.id) from (select * from organizations order by opens desc,id limit 100) o),'[]'::jsonb),
    'organization_count',(select count(*) from organizations)
  ) into v_result;
  return v_result;
end;
$function$

functions.name: get_public_asset
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.get_public_asset(p_path text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select p_path is not null and p_path ~ '^[0-9a-f-]{36}/(branding|menu|pages)/[0-9a-f-]{36}\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$' and exists (
    select 1 from public.organizations o join public.pages p on p.organization_id = o.id
    where o.is_active and p.is_published and (
      p_path in (o.logo_path,o.cover_path)
      or (p.content->>'photo_path' = p_path and p_path like o.id::text || '/pages/%')
      or (p.type = 'menu' and exists (select 1 from public.menu_items i
        join public.menu_categories c on c.id = i.category_id and c.organization_id = i.organization_id
        where i.organization_id = o.id and i.image_path = p_path and i.is_published and c.is_active))
    )
  );
$function$

functions.name: get_public_page
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.get_public_page(p_slug text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'organization', jsonb_build_object('id',o.id,'name',o.name,'slug',o.slug,'description',o.description,
      'logo_path',o.logo_path,'cover_path',o.cover_path,'phone',o.phone,'email',o.email,'address',o.address,
      'maps_url',o.maps_url,'facebook_url',o.facebook_url,'instagram_url',o.instagram_url,'website_url',o.website_url,
      'primary_color',o.primary_color,'secondary_color',o.secondary_color),
    'page', jsonb_build_object('id',p.id,'slug',p.slug,'title',p.title,'type',p.type,'description',p.description,
      'content',coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(k,v) from jsonb_each(p.content) as x(k,v)
        where k in ('person_name','position','phone','email','website','services','links','photo_path')), '{}'::jsonb)),
    'categories',case when p.type = 'menu' then coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'name',c.name,'sort_order',c.sort_order) order by c.sort_order,c.name)
      from public.menu_categories c where c.organization_id = o.id and c.is_active), '[]'::jsonb) else '[]'::jsonb end,
    'items',case when p.type = 'menu' then coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',i.id,'category_id',i.category_id,
      'name_mn',i.name_mn,'name_en',i.name_en,'description',i.description,'price_mnt',i.price_mnt,'image_path',i.image_path,
      'is_available',i.is_available,'sort_order',i.sort_order) order by i.sort_order,i.name_mn)
      from public.menu_items i join public.menu_categories c on c.id = i.category_id and c.organization_id = i.organization_id
      where i.organization_id = o.id and i.is_published and c.is_active), '[]'::jsonb) else '[]'::jsonb end
  ) from public.pages p join public.organizations o on o.id = p.organization_id
    where p.slug = p_slug and p.is_published and o.is_active;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.has_permission(p_organization_id uuid, p_permission text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select auth.uid() is not null and (private.is_platform_admin() or exists (
    select 1 from public.organization_members where organization_id = p_organization_id and user_id = (select auth.uid())
      and (role = 'owner' or (p_permission is not null and p_permission = any(permissions)))
  ));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.list_platform_users()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, email text, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not private.is_platform_admin() then raise exception 'Platform admin required' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  return query select u.id, u.email::text, u.created_at from auth.users u order by u.created_at desc limit 1000;
end;
$function$

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((maps_url = ''::text) OR (maps_url ~ '^https://[^/@[:space:]]+([/?#][^[:space:]]*)?$'::text)) AND ((facebook_url = ''::text) OR (facebook_url ~ '^https://[^/@[:space:]]+([/?#][^[:space:]]*)?$'::text)) AND ((instagram_url = ''::text) OR (instagram_url ~ '^https://[^/@[:space:]]+([/?#][^[:space:]]*)?$'::text)) AND ((website_url = ''::text) OR (website_url ~ '^https://[^/@[:space:]]+([/?#][^[:space:]]*)?$'::text)))) NOT VALID
